Peak Pickleball sponsorships

Sponsor add-ons: what we can offer

The tech sideof a Peak Pickleball sponsorship

Tracking and reportsProof of what the sponsorship did.

  1. Tracked QR codesYour own QR codes for court signs, banners and table tents. Every scan is counted.
  2. Monthly sponsor reportOne page each month with your scans, clicks, visits and results in one place.
  3. Website visitor statsSimple, cookie-free counts of who visits your website, added to your report.
  4. Social media statsReach, followers and clicks from your pages, added to your report.

At PeakYour business in front of Peak members.

  1. Sponsor slides on Peak's TVsYour business in a rotating reel on the screens around the club, including "Court 4 presented by" boards.
  2. Partner spot in member emailsA "This month's partner" feature in Peak's emails to members.
  3. Sponsor page on Peak's websiteA profile of your business on peakpickleball.us with links to you.
  4. Staff sign-up linkIf your sponsorship includes memberships for your team: a sign-up link that shows how many joined and played.
  5. "Presented by" tournaments and leaguesYour name on brackets, results, the TV boards and the results email.
  6. Event sign-upsA tablet sign-up at events, such as a raffle or a free lesson. You get entries only from people who opt in.
  7. Court cameras and replaysMatch replays with your business on screen.
  8. Wi-Fi sign-in pageYour business on the page members see when they join Peak's Wi-Fi.

WebsiteYour own website, working harder.

  1. Website health checkA look at speed, mobile, broken links, Google basics and forms, with a clear fix list or the fixes done.
  2. Landing page for your Peak offerA simple page for your member deal and QR codes to point to, with visits counted.
  3. Forms that alert youContact and quote forms that email or text you the moment someone fills one in.
  4. New website or redesignA new site built for you, quoted as its own project.
  5. Hosting and upkeepYour site kept updated, backed up and fixed each month.

Search and reviewsGetting found on Google and building trust.

  1. Local search (SEO)Work on your Google listing and local search results, with a monthly report.
  2. Google review requestsA QR code or text link that asks happy customers for a review, with new reviews counted each month.
  3. Review alertsA heads-up whenever a new review lands, good or bad.

Social mediaYour pages, kept active.

  1. Profile cleanupBios, links, hours and photos tidied and matched across Facebook, Instagram and Google.
  2. Monthly postsA month of posts drafted for you. Nothing goes out until you approve it.
  3. Spotlight posts with PeakPeak features your business on its socials, ready for you to share.
  4. Short videos from PeakClips of your name on the courts, at events and with the winners, for your own pages.

MarketingBringing in customers.

  1. Member deals with codesA special offer for Peak members with its own code, so you see real redemptions.
  2. Local ads on Facebook and InstagramAds set up and run for your area only, with results reported.
  3. Customer email newsletterA monthly email to your own customers, with opens and clicks counted.
